name: Anileridine

similar.name: Fenspiride
problems: Pulled from the market in European Union, first in 2019 — for heart harm

similar.name: Enalapril
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for harm to an unborn baby and heart harm

summary: A small computer program, rather than tests on people, calculated a low score of 32 for liver risk and a high score of 72 for heart risk for Anileridine [M]. Meanwhile, a related drug named Fenspiride was removed from the European Union market starting in 2019 due to heart damage [3]. Another similar drug, Enalapril, has a serious boxed warning in the United States regarding heart damage and harm to an unborn baby [4].
